configuredBrushTiming.scope: Wall time for native Swift brush painting only. Setup and hashing excluded. Two paired process runs, each with two timed samples after warmup, per architecture and build.

packagedSnapshot.mode: Existing --snapshot-small AppKit/SwiftUI command from the exact extracted package.

repeatedPreparation.scope: Native painting only, nine prefixes of a fixed 240-sample stroke on a 24 MP raster, two trials per build and diameter. Both builds retain raster coverage. Build 549 samples large dabs in parallel. No window or display measurements.
